title: The Empty Vault
summary: The scroll is stolen, and its clones attack the academy.

lines: The vault seal was cut, not broken. Whoever did this knew our seals.
The Scroll of Five Natures is gone. In the wrong hands it makes clones without end.
Clones like the one from my trial?
That one was polite. These won't be.
And there they are. The thief left us a welcome party. Hold the yard, {name}. I'll guard the vault.
Wind clones and earth clones? The thief can't even pick a nature.
Because the scroll holds all five. The clones fled toward the Ashen Pass.
And I know those seal cuts. I taught them.
Years ago. He had a gift for fire and no patience for anything else. His name is Kagerou.
We follow at nightfall. Rest while you can.
